name: Collar
long_description:
Collar is YC’s first investor relations startup, building AI-native investor relations for public companies.

Traction: $1.4M deals pending compliance in 2 months since YC started. 
30 partners including Fortune 500, NYSE and NASDAQ-listed companies.
67% week over week growth in enterprise bookings.

Our proprietary agentic AI harness performs two-thirds of an investor relations team’s work, solving a $16B global market.

Founders: Kazel and Jamie are both repeat founders with buy-side finance experience. 
Kazel invented a new method of hacking with Softbank research funding at 17 before being recruited into Singapore’s Intelligence Service. 
Jamie was Chief of Staff at Openspace, a billion-dollar multi-asset manager.

They previously worked together as the youngest Singapore defence contractors.
one_liner: AI-Native Investor Relations For Public Companies
